name: manage_intel
description: Create, read, update, delete, or list intel files in jarvis-intel/ directory. Use this to programmatically manage your knowledge base files. Sandboxed to jarvis-intel/ only. IMPORTANT: jarvis-intel/ is FLAT - use simple filenames like 'bitcoin-price-2025-11-19.md', NOT subdirectories like 'bitcoin/price.md'. After creating/updating intel files, set auto_ingest=true to automatically add facts to memory. Actions: 'create', 'read', 'update', 'delete', 'list'. Examples: Create a new note about a server, update existing documentation, delete outdated intel.

action.description: Action to perform: create (new file), read (get content), update (modify existing), delete (remove file + memories), list (show all files)

path.description: Relative path within jarvis-intel/ (e.g., 'servers/coolify-issue.md' or 'network-config.txt'). Required for create/read/update/delete.

content.description: File content (markdown or plain text). Required for create/update actions.

pattern.description: File name pattern for list action (e.g., '*server*'). Defaults to '*' (all files).

auto_ingest.description: If true, automatically run ingest_intel after create/update/delete to update memory. Recommended: true.
